Detailed Description

Style class for application menu. 

        MApplicationMenuStyle {
            canvas-image: "canvas-background" 3mm 3mm 3mm 3mm;
            canvas-color: #000000;
            canvas-opacity: 1.0;
            canvas-margin: 12;

            divider-image:;
            divider-color: #F9A427;
            divider-opacity: 1.0;
            divider-width: 1;

            item-height: 88;
            gap-height: 1;
            gap-color: #F9A427;
            gap-opacity: 1.0;
        }
